# Environment variable reference

## Required at install (wizard)

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `APP_URL` | Public URL of the Laravel API |
| `FRONTEND_URL` | Public URL of the Next.js dashboard |
| `ADMIN_EMAIL` / `ADMIN_PASSWORD` | First superadmin account |

## Auto-generated by installer

`APP_KEY`, `JWT_SECRET`, `DB_PASSWORD`, `REVERB_APP_ID`, `REVERB_APP_KEY`, `REVERB_APP_SECRET`

## Configured after login (Admin → Integrations)

Preferred path: save in the dashboard. Values are stored encrypted in `platform_settings` and override `.env` at runtime.

| Group | Fields |
|-------|--------|
| Coolify | API URL, token, server/project/GitHub App UUIDs, environment, metrics host |
| GitHub | organization, admin PAT, private repos, connector plugin repo/ref |
| Stripe | publishable key, secret, webhook secret, currency, mode, sync enabled |

Env fallbacks still work for existing Coolify deploys (`COOLIFY_*`, `GITHUB_*`, `STRIPE_*`).

## Optional env

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `MAIL_*` | SMTP (default `MAIL_MAILER=log`) |
| `GITHUB_CLIENT_ID/SECRET` | OAuth login |
| `N8N_*` | Optional n8n publish path (disabled by default) |
